programme.title: Legendäre Zugabenteuer

programme.title: Halloween III: Season of the Witch
programme.desc: Hospital emergency room Dr. Daniel "Dan" Challis (Tom Atkins) and Ellie Grimbridge (Stacey Nelkin), the daughter of a murder victim, uncover a terrible plot by small-town mask maker Conal Cochran (Dan O'Herlihy), a madman who's planning a Halloween mass murder utilizing an ancient Celtic ritual. The ritual involves a boulder stolen from Stonehenge, the use of Silver Shamrock masks and a triggering device contained in a television commercial -- all designed to kill millions of children.

programme.title: Halloween
programme.desc: On a cold Halloween night in 1963, six-year-old Michael Myers brutally murdered his 17-year-old sister, Judith. He was sentenced and locked away for 15 years. But on October 30, 1978, while being transferred for a court date, a 21-year-old Michael Myers steals a car and escapes Smith's Grove. He returns to his quiet hometown of Haddonfield, Illinois, where he looks for his next victims.

programme.title: Halloween II
programme.desc: After failing to kill stubborn survivor Laurie (Jamie Lee Curtis) and taking a bullet or six from former psychiatrist Dr. Sam Loomis (Donald Pleasence), Michael Myers (Jonathan Prince) has followed Laurie to the Haddonfield Memorial Hospital, where she's been admitted for Myers' attempt on her life. The institution proves to be particularly suited to serial killers, however, as Myers cuts, stabs and slashes his way through hospital staff to reach his favorite victim.

programme.title: Sea Patrol

programme.title: Sea Patrol

programme.title: Sea Patrol

(Senderinfo).

programme.title: Sea Patrol

(Senderinfo).

programme.title: Sea Patrol

Von den zwei Schiffen, die auf dem Radar der Hammersley auftauchen, wird eines von ihnen gestoppt. (Senderinfo).

programme.title: Sea Patrol

(Senderinfo).

programme.title: Sea Patrol

programme.title: Sea Patrol

programme.title: Sea Patrol
programme.desc: Wegen ihres aufbrausenden Temperaments gerät Bomber, der neue Smutje an Bord der Hammerley, mit den anderen Crewmitgliedern immer wieder aneinander. Spider macht sich einen Spaß daraus, sie wegen ihrer Weigerung, Frittiertes zuzubereiten, zur Weißglut zu bringen. (Senderinfo).

programme.title: Sea Patrol
programme.desc: Die Crew der Hammersley verfolgt illegale Einwanderer, die sie schließlich auf offener See auf einer Sandbank aufgreifen. programme.title: Rewilding: Back to Nature
programme.desc: Worldwide, there are various projects and approaches to give nature more space again. The aim is to create larger wilderness areas that develop with hardly any influence of humans - by reintroducing so-called key animal species and creating a network of wilderness corridors across entire continents. Rewilding promises to be a cost-effective form of conservation in which we can boost biodiversity and protect the climate.

programme.title: Montenegro - From the Black Mountains to the Beach
programme.desc: The Balkan land of Montenegro owes its name to the Black Mountains. But there is so much more: steep cliffs, deep gorges, picturesque lakes, orthodox monasteries, Venetian architecture, sandy beaches and even fjords like those of Norway. There are three climate zones alone in the Adriatic. The inhabitants still try to find their way between the challenges of a post-socialist system, the much-vaunted Balkan remoteness and the opportunities of a still almost completely undiscovered tourist destination in Europe.

programme.title: Legendary Paddle Steamers
programme.sub-title: Following the Scottish West Coast with "Waverley"
programme.desc: Rugged coasts, untouched nature and the rough climate of the Atlantic characterize the landscape on the west coast of Scotland. In the sounds and lochs of the Scottish West, "Waverley", the last seaworthy passenger steamship in the world, appears once a year. The side-wheel steamer was built in 1947 to carry out short ferry passages on the Clyde River. Today, "Waverley" circumnavigates almost all of Great Britain. The impressive ship was sold to the "Paddle Steamer Preservation Society" in 1974 for the symbolic price of one English pound. Since then, she starts her season off the Western Isles in Scotland every year in May.

programme.title: Legendary Paddle Steamers
programme.sub-title: Across the lake Vierwaldstättersee with the “Unterwalden”
programme.desc: Lake Lucerne in the heart of Switzerland stretches from the foothills of the Alps to the first three-thousand-meter peaks of the high mountains. Home waters of the paddle steamer Unterwalden. For two and a half years she was not on the water. Now, after the biggest renovation in her history, the life of the 110-year-old paddle steamer is starting all over again. Her first voyages, with all the imponderables and challenges for the crew, take her into a diverse, wild landscape, right into the mystical heart of Switzerland. In their territory, scenic contrasts collide: barren high moorland and gently rolling alpine meadows, modern tourist resorts and quiet mountain villages, caves hidden deep in the earth and snow-covered two-thousand-meter peaks. The Unterwalden is part of the oldest and largest fleet of paddle steamers so high above the sea. Here on Lake Lucerne, according to national legend, the three original cantons swore eternal allegiance to each other over seven hundred years ago. A land around which countless myths entwine and whose lifeline since the opening of the Gotthard Pass in the thirteenth century was the shipping traffic on the lake.

programme.title: Fertile Floods - Croatia's Wetlands
programme.desc: Every year, in the middle of Croatia, it's the same story: after the annual snowmelt, a huge flood wave spills out of the Alps toward Zagreb and Belgrade. This leads to an increase in the River Sava's water levels of some ten metres. The contents of more than ten billion bathtubs floods an area the size of Lake Constance, often for months on end, yet still the Croatian and Serbian capital is spared a flood disaster. One of the reasons for this is the fact that the Sava is able to flow unhindered. The annual floods not only create a natural retention reservoir for flood control: alongside the Sava lies a natural paradise, unique in Central Europe. In the species-rich, alluvial flood forests of the last major meadow landscapes of the continent, enormous predatory fish like the catfish lie in wait for prey. The fertile floodplains of the Sava are an important resting place for more than 240 bird species, including Hoopoe, great crested Grebe, little Egret, common snipe and pied Avocet. Old, domestic livestock breeds like the Turopolje pig and Posavina horse spend almost the entire year in the floodplains. They appreciate the alluvial meadows, keep puddles and mudholes open whilst wallowing and, as living lawnmowers, they ensure that the moist meadows aren't transformed into dense oak forests. Thanks to this traditional pasture farming, more than 700 pairs of white stork alone breed in the Lonjsko Polje National Park. The Sava Floodplains allow us to glance into the past of our continent and at the same time, illustrate just how flood protection for major towns can be perfected.

programme.title: Moon, The: Our Gateway To The Universe
programme.desc: We are on the verge of a new age of exploration: besides the plans of NASA and other space agencies, over the next years also privately financed teams are going to send unmanned vehicles to the Moon. The goal is to find a cheap and efficient way to travel there on a regular basis, and in the long term to build a permanent human base.

programme.title: Baltic National Parks
programme.desc: Lahemaa National Park on Estonias Baltic coast features ancient forests, rivers and peninsulas where nature has remained largely untouched.

programme.title: Baltic National Parks
programme.desc: Soomaa National Park is one of Europes wettest wilderness areas. Floods, forests and wetlands create a landscape where canoes replace roads during the fifth season.

programme.title: Lunenburg: Where the Land Meets the Sea
programme.desc: On the east coast of Canada, a place whose name sounds strangely familiar. The small town of Lunenburg, west of Halifax, was founded in 1753 by North German immigrants. Today, the idyllic town with its many wooden houses is a UNESCO World Heritage Site. In the 19th century, Lunenburg was one of the richest towns in the British Empire, becoming prosperous through fishing and shipbuilding. Glenn Rhodenizer's family traces back ten generations directly to German immigrants. And what the Rhodenizers primarily grow on their fields directly by the sea could hardly be more typical: it is white cabbage, which the farming family processes into sauerkraut. Sauerkraut can be found in every restaurant and supermarket in this area; it is the specialty of the region. The heritage of wooden boat building is successfully maintained by David Westergard. In his ancient shed, he is assembling a 20-meter schooner from four different types of local wood. Building wooden boats, he says, is like "slow food": sustainable, conscious, environmentally friendly, waste-free.

programme.title: Caribbean sisters: The Lesser Antilles St. Kitts & Nevis
programme.desc: In the centre of the Caribbean, volcanoes rise steeply from the sea, thus shaping the sister islands of St. Kitts & Nevis. Their slopes, covered in lush rainforests, snow-white, sandy beaches and the surrounding tur-quoise tinted waters provide the ultimate setting for this record-breaking, albeit tiny island paradise: Both islets are the smallest of the Caribbean dwarf states and also rank among the world’s ten smallest states. A hot pepper sauce, made of a creative mixture of ginger, garlic, thyme and extraordinarily hot chillies that thrive in the hot and humid climate of Nevis, is simmering on the stove of Violet and Llewellyn’s house. Lemmy Pemberton digs up abandoned turtle nests with his bare hands, as he wants to be certain that all of the babies have indeed managed to make it. Members of the Turtle Group catch sea turtles in order to take their measurements and fit them with transmitters. Taxi bus-es are not only the main means of transport on St. Kitts & Nevis, they are also an artistic expression of each driver’s personality. Colourfully embellished, each taxi represents island art on wheels.

programme.title: Portugal's Nature Parks
programme.desc: The "Parque Natural da Ria Formosa" is one of the largest lagoon conservation areas in Europe. Bordered by five natural islands. A mosaic of sandbanks, brackish and freshwater lagoons and salt marshes. In 2010, the "Ria Formosa" was chosen as one of the seven natural wonders of Portugal. It is a unique ecosystem: in the winter months, more than 20,000 birds gather here. In addition, the nature park has one of the largest seahorse populations internationally. More than half of all fish species in the Atlantic are said to spawn in the lagoon.

programme.title: Portugal's Nature Parks
programme.desc: The Parque Nacional Peneda-Gerês is the only national park in Portugal. An area of almost 700 square kilometers, located in the extreme north of Portugal. Barren and rocky ridges in the plateaus, contrast with large forests and lush ground vegetation in deep valleys, crossed by lakes and rivers. The park is known for its oak forests, which are predominantly pedunculate and Pyrenean oaks. Among the typical animals of the park are the small Garrano ponies, a very old breed of horse and the only one in Europe that still lives in the wild.

programme.title: Portugal's Nature Parks
programme.sub-title: South West Portugal: Alentejano and Costa Vicentina
programme.desc: In the southwest of Portugal lies the little known Parque Natural do Sudoeste Alentejano e Costa Vicentina. It encompasses a narrow coastal strip that runs along the coast to the south of Portugal. Sparsely populated, this coastal region, which was placed under protection in 1988, is considered one of the last intact ecosystems in Europe. The steep cliffs, the almost constant wind and high waves have ensured that mass tourism has not gained a foothold here. There are still near-natural forests and a diverse bird life.

programme.title: The Heart of Hawaii - The Island of Oahu
programme.desc: The Oahu island is the economic and cultural centre of the Hawaiian archipelago, as well as being a paradise for surfers, active holidaymakers and freedom lovers. The island is home to more than half of all natives and almost eight million foreign guests annually. Anyone searching for peace and seclusion won’t find either in Honolulu or Waikiki. Traffic congestion and a backdrop of skyscrapers belong to the town panorama. Hip cafes, galleries and young fashion firms have settled here, adding a new and modern flair to the capital. Cindy’s Lei Shoppe, the Chinatown florists, has been here for more than 30 years. This is also because the so-called Leis, the tradition of floral decoration, usually offered as a flower necklace or as a headdress, is still an important part of Hawaiian culture. Keone Nunes is well-known for his traditional tattooing skills, whereby the so-called Kakau Tattoos are virtually hammered into the skin with a hippo tooth. But Oahu is also an island of overwhelming natural beauty and a fascinating diversity on the smallest of places ...

programme.title: Secrets of the North Sea
programme.desc: The North Sea is enigmatic. It presents itself in cool shades of grey. Yet who would have guessed that beneath the chilly waves are opulent coral gardens, courting squids, and several of the largest sea creatures on the planet?

programme.title: Bosnia Herzegovina
programme.desc: Wild and unknown lies the still undiscovered natural paradise of Bosnia and Herzegovina in the heart of Europe. Rough mountains, dense forests and wild waterfalls characterize the picture of the untouched landscapes. Lynx, wolves and bears roam mountains and valleys. One of the last primeval forests in Europe is a retreat for many endangered animal species. Bosnia and Herzegovina is actually an undiscovered natural paradise in the middle of Europe.

programme.title: Bosnia Herzegovina
programme.desc: The barren, karstic south of the country, Herzegovina, also impresses with its natural landscapes. One of them is the Livno field. Not only is it the largest wetland in the country, it is also the largest regularly flooded karst field in the world. About 700 wild horses live in this unique landscape. Their ancestors were working horses that were abandoned here more than 50 years ago. Another special feature of the karst landscape are the rivers with their tufa barriers. The countless waterfalls that pour over it are a unique natural phenomenon.

programme.title: mareTV: Jersey - Sunshine Island in the English Channel
programme.desc: Jersey: the Channel Island is one of the areas in the UK that can boast the most hours of annual sunshine. Not that Dave Cowburn cares very much. He works in the dark, cool ducts of an old bunker from the Sec-ond World War. Here, he breeds turbot, and is very successful at it, too. The "Jersey Royal", the regal potato, has been grown on the island since 1880, fertilized with seaweed from the surrounding ocean. In the third generation, Christine Hellio manages approximately 20 hectares on the coast. "The potato is our most important export commodity", she says. It is harvested by hand, as machines cannot be used on the steep fields. The price is quite regal, too: One kilogram costs 6 Euros. Hugh Gill is one of around 240 voluntary police officers on Jersey. The Honorary Police is regarded as the oldest organised police system in the world. Hugh works for them for one week every month. On the green lanes, the streets of Jersey, the speed limit is 15 miles per hour. Jersey has an immense tidal range and with up to 13 metres difference, it is the world's third largest. This is good for a rarity: the Ormer - one of the world's most expensive species of snail.

programme.title: mareTV: Mexico's Caribbean Coast
programme.desc: The palm tree laden beaches on Mexico's Riviera Maya on the Yucatan peninsula are endless, and the turquoise sea with its gentle Caribbean surf is a warm 25 degrees during the mild winter in this part of the world. Between Cancún and Punta Allen, where once there was little more than bushland and a few sleepy fishing villages, vibrant life has evolved during the past three decades. Richard Sowa has lived on a floating island for the past 15 years: an island he built himself out of empty plastic bottles. The bon vivant him-self sees it as a "solution for our planet's refuse problem". Off Punta Allen, a village in the bay of Sian Ka'an, Mexican Mara Coral Ley and her cousin Kim, continue to catch lobsters by adhering to the traditional method and were awarded an "Eco seal for sustainable fishing" for their trouble. It is silent under water off Isla Mujeres and it is here that the artist Jason deCaires has constructed a sculpture park. Hundreds of lifesize figures form an artificial reef at a depth of 12 metres. Fish and plants complete his work of art. The master himself is convinced: "Mother Nature is the true artist".

programme.title: Hot Roads - The Worlds Most Dangerous Roads
programme.desc: The Sichuan Tibet Highway is the road of longing for many. It leads through fascinating landscapes and remote areas up to the Himalayan Mountains. We accompany truck driver Ren Taiping on his trip to the Tibetan capital city of Lhasa, encountering pilgrims, mountain bikers and nomads on this dangerous journey.

programme.title: Hot Roads - The Worlds Most Dangerous Roads
programme.desc: The racing cyclists of Burundi have a dangerous job. But it’s a vital one for Burundi’s economy. Bicycles are the main means of transportation in one of the smallest countries in Africa. Bananas, the staple food in Burundi, are transported from the markets to a banana beer brewing factory. We accompany Tharcien, a bike courier, on his exhausting cross country trip on the Burundi Highway.

programme.title: Hot Roads - The Worlds Most Dangerous Roads
programme.desc: The Canadian ice roads exist only for a few months in the winter when the ice is thick enough. The only time of the year when goods can be transported up to Northern Manitoba. We accompany the truckers Vlad and Hugh as well as the aboriginal Canadian Scott with his pick-up on their long journey to a village called God’s Lake. A risky trip in icy temperatures, sometimes even below - 60 degrees Celcius. The men are in constant danger of getting stuck and need to forget everything they ever learnt about driving on a highway in order to arrive safely.

programme.title: Wild Prairie Man
programme.desc: Located in the Northern Great Plains of Canada, Grasslands National Park has been a 20 year odyssey for wildlife photographer James R. Page. For James, critters are more interesting than people and he shares some of his iconic images and experiences from this endangered ecosystem. We showcase the parks wilderness that is dominated by prairie light and dark sky, the wildlife, prairie dogs, mesmerizing landscapes, and bisons. We immerse ourselves in the wild habitat of Grasslands National Park for over a year capturing some never before scenes in the Wild Prairie. James R. Page's connection to the land and the wildlife provides an unforgettable journey into the heart of this endangered ecosystem, while Park experts help us understand its complexity.

programme.title: Countries People Adventures - Iceland Extreme
programme.desc: In southeastern Iceland, Europe's largest glacier, the gigantic Vatnajökull, covers an area of around 9,000 square kilometers. Beneath it lie the world's most active and dangerous volcanoes. This extreme landscape is as dangerous as it is fascinating: glistening white glacier tongues, lagoons covered with icebergs, bizarre green lava mountains, snow-covered volcanic cones, solidified lava flows and imposing waterfalls overwhelm everyone who gets to see them. In 2008, Icelanders declared the glacier and adjacent areas a national park, the largest in Europe. In this documentary, the team meets people who live, work or do research here: a life with the dangers of fire and ice in the overwhelming landscape of Vatnajökull National Park.

programme.title: Elephants: Back to the Wild
programme.sub-title: Elephants: Back to the Wild: The Orphanage of Elephants - Nairobi Nationalpark
programme.desc: We follow the rescue of a baby elephant. Once rescued, it will be transported by plane to the breeding station and raised with love and commitment. In order to satisfy the little pachyderm’s urge to move while in the breeding station, there is sometimes an adorable football match between the animals.

programme.title: Super Password
programme.desc: Like the 1960s version, two contestants, each teamed with a celebrity partner, compete in a word-association game. The team with the most points at the end of the round gets to go on to a fast-paced bonus round called Cashword.

programme.title: The Price Is Right
programme.desc: "Come on down!" "The Price Is Right" -- hosted by Bob Barker until 2007 and Drew Carey thereafter -- features a wide variety of games and contests with the same basic challenge: Guess the prices of everyday (or not-quite-everyday) retail items. Four contestants, all of whom are seated in one of the wildest audiences in daytime game-show history, are called to the stage to play a preliminary pricing round. That winner joins the host on stage for one of more than 70 different pricing games. After three such games, the contestants spin a big wheel -- hoping to get as close to $1 as possible -- in the "Showcase Showdown." The two highest winners of that round advance to the final, where prizes could be cars or roomsful of furniture. A trio of models presents the prizes.

Four contestants, all of whom are seated in one of the wildest audiences in daytime game-show history, are called to the stage to play a preliminary pricing round. The two highest winners of that round advance to the final, where prizes could be cars or roomsful of furniture. A trio of models presents the prizes.

The Switch
programme.desc: Neurotic Wally Mars has one bright spot in his life: his friendship with Kassie. When Kassie announces her intention to become pregnant using a sperm donor, Wally thinks he will be the lucky guy, but Kassie has someone else in mind. While drunk at Kassie's insemination party, Wally substitutes his sperm for the donor's, then passes out, remembering nothing. Seven years later, Wally meets Kassie's son, who seems oddly familiar to him.

programme.title: Futurama
programme.desc: Um die vorlauten Harlem Globetrotters in ihre Schranken zu weisen, will Farnsworth sie mit einem Mutanten-Team im Basketball schlagen. Damit seine Babymutanten rechtzeitig die nötige Reife erlangen, setzt er Chronitons ein, um deren Alterung zu beschleunigen. Doch die Wirkung der Chronitons beschränkt sich nicht auf die Mutanten sondern lässt die Zeit insgesamt zunehmend schneller ablaufen….

programme.title: Futurama
programme.desc: Im New York des Jahres 3000 ist es mit der Liebe kompliziert: Fry hat sich in einen Roboter mit den Daten der sexy Schauspielerin Lucy Liu („Ally McBeal“, „Elementary“) verknallt…\n\nEin kerniger Spaß von „Simpsons“-Erfinder Matt Groening.

programme.title: Futurama
programme.desc: Einfaltspinsel Fry auf Stippvisite in der Vergangenheit. Sein Ziel: Roswell im Jahr 1947… \n\nDie Start-Episode „Roswell gut – alles gut“ heimste 2002 einen Emmy, den US-TV-Oskar, ein.

programme.title: Futurama
programme.desc: Durch die „Was wäre wenn Maschine“, die der Professor erfunden hat, sieht man, das Bender nur noch frisst und säuft, wenn er ein Mensch wäre. Fry hingegen erlebt ein Videospiel als reale Welt, während Leela auf einem Planeten im „The Wizard of Oz“-Stil landet.

programme.title: Futurama
programme.desc: Ein echter Herzensbrecher: Roboter Bender verdreht dem Bordcomputer des Raumschiffs die Schaltkreise. Doch Bender gehen die Annäherungsversuche bald auf die Nerven. Wer kann schon ahnen, was verschmähte Liebe in den Schaltkreisen eines sensiblen Bordcomputers auslöst?

programme.desc: 'S1/E1 - Wind And Ocean'. In the Arctic, the high Alps, and off the coast of Florida, scientists are studying the huge ocean and air currents that make our weather-and rule our lives.

programme.title: Welt der Zukunft
programme.desc: Strombetriebene Fahrzeuge sind immer verbreiteter und gelten als großer Hoffnungsträger, wenn es um einen klimafreundlicheren Personen- und Güterverkehr geht. Doch damit sie zur neuen Normalität werden können, gilt es noch so manche Hürden zu überwinden – sowohl in technischer Hinsicht als auch in unseren Köpfen. (Senderinfo).

programme.title: Welt der Zukunft
programme.desc: Das Metaversum gilt als Nachfolger des Internets. Hier sollen Realität und virtuelle Welt noch enger miteinander verschmelzen. Doch es gibt ganz verschiedene Vorstellungen davon, wie das konkret aussehen soll – sicher ist nur, dass es unser Leben und die Art, auf die wir miteinander kommunizieren, maßgeblich verändern wird. (Senderinfo).

programme.title: Spaniens Lithium-Schatz
programme.desc: Die nur dünn besiedelte Extremadura gilt als wirtschaftlich schwächste Region Spaniens. Jetzt hat eine Bergbaufirma dort ein riesiges Lithiumvorkommen entdeckt – bislang das wohl zweitgrößte Europas. Mit steigender Nachfrage nach dem Leichtmetall scheinen Wohlstand und Wachstum für die Region plötzlich greifbar. Doch die geplante Mine droht ein Naturparadies zu zerstören. (Senderinfo).

programme.title: Angriff des Zombie-Pilzes
programme.desc: Wir sehen Pilze oft als unterstes Glied der Nahrungskette, als die Recycler im Kreislauf des Lebens. Aber Pilze sind Raubtiere. Sie ernähren sich von Leben. Und es gibt mehr davon, als wir jemals gedacht hätten. Während wir uns in jeden Winkel der Erde ausbreiten, entdecken auch sie uns – und dass wir möglicherweise der perfekte Wirt sind. (Senderinfo).

programme.title: Katzen – Geheimnisvolle Mitbewohner
programme.desc: Sie sind kuschelig und verspielt, gelten aber gleichzeitig als unnahbar, abweisend und emotionslos. Oft schon haben wir uns gefragt: Hat der Mensch die Katzen jemals wirklich domestiziert? Und was kann uns die Wissenschaft noch über eine Beziehung sagen, die ihren Ursprung in der Frühzeit der Zivilisation hat? (Senderinfo).

programme.title: Hunde – Verlässliche Weggefährten
programme.desc: Hunde sind seit Tausenden von Jahren unsere Begleiter. Aber lieben die Tiere uns wirklich, oder geht es ihnen nur um das Futter? Wissenschaftler testen die Intelligenz von Wölfen, sie entschlüsseln die DNA von Hunden und blicken in ihre Gehirne, um herauszufinden, was Domestizierung wirklich bedeutet. (Senderinfo).

programme.title: Das Leiden der Modehunde
programme.desc: Kulleraugen, Stupsnase, kleine Schädel – Hunderassen wie Mops, Chihuahua oder Bulldogge sind wegen ihres niedlichen Äußeren gefragt. Doch diese Modezüchtungen leiden häufig unter Atemwegs- und Augenerkrankungen, den Zähnen oder der Wirbelsäule – oft ein ganzes Leben lang. Für die Besitzer ist das nicht nur emotional, sondern auch finanziell belastend. (Senderinfo).

programme.title: Meine Katze aus Damaskus
programme.desc: Mehr als eine Million Menschen kamen auf der Flucht vor dem Bürgerkrieg in Syrien in Europa unter. Die meisten von ihnen ließen alles zurück: Angehörige, Freunde, Besitz, aber auch ihre geliebten Haustiere. Eine Syrerin, die selbst aus Damaskus floh und heute in den Niederlanden lebt, hilft ihren Landsleuten bei der Wiedervereinigung mit ihren Vierbeinern. (Senderinfo).

programme.title: Deutschland auf dem Ökotrip
programme.desc: Sie sind Schmuse-Partner, essen artig vom Löffel und singen sogar Lieder. Heute erfahren längst nicht nur die klassischen Haustiere Zuwendung, die das erforderliche Maß übersteigt. Die Vermenschlichung der Kreatur schreitet scheinbar unaufhaltsam voran. So werden selbst aus Alligatoren oder Geparden Kuschelfreunde, was Mensch und Tier gleichermaßen schadet. (Senderinfo).

programme.title: Beeindruckende Spürnasen
programme.desc: Hunde verfügen über einen außerordentlich guten Geruchssinn. Dank ihrer hervorragenden Nasen können Hunde Menschen nicht nur dabei helfen, Dinge wie Sprengstoff, vermisste Personen oder illegale Drogen aufzuspüren. Laut neuesten Forschungsergebnissen können die Vierbeiner sogar Krankheiten wie zum Beispiel Krebs erschnüffeln. (Senderinfo).

programme.title: Die Hippos sind los – Pablo Escobars Erbe
programme.desc: Flusspferde zählen zu den massigsten Landsäugetieren der Erde und gelten sie äußerst gefährlich, besonders Mütter mit Jungtieren. Nachts verlassen sie das Wasser und ziehen kilometerweit zu neuen Weideplätzen. Die von Pablo Escobar in Kolumbien eingeführten Hippos, die jetzt als invasive Art dort leben, bedrohen jedoch nicht nur Menschen, sondern auch die heimische Tier- und Pflanzenwelt. (Senderi

programme.title: Airbus A310 MRTT – Das fliegende Multitalent
programme.desc: Truppenverlegungen in alle Welt, Luftbetankungen oder Krankentransporte: Die Männer und Frauen der Flugbereitschaft des Verteidigungsministeriums sind ständig unterwegs. Ihr Arbeitsgerät ist der Airbus A310 MRTT. SPIEGEL TV Wissen begleitete Mannschaften der Luftwaffe bei einem Transportflug nach Mali sowie bei einer Luftbetankungsmission über der Nordsee. (Senderinfo).

programme.title: Containerschiff XXL
programme.desc: 400 Meter lang – so groß wie vier Fußballfelder – und 63 Meter breit: Das sind die Maße des größten, jemals gebauten Containerschiffs. Dank seines riesigen Elf-Zylinder-Motors der neuesten Generation und der revolutionären Nutzung von Flüssigerdgas hat es genug Kraft, um zehn Einheiten des A380, des größten Flugzeugs von Airbus, zu bewegen. (Senderinfo).

programme.title: The Demolition Man
programme.desc: Brücken gehören zum Rückgrat unserer Infrastruktur. Müssen sie aus Altersgründen einem Neubau weichen, ist Präzisionsarbeit gefragt. Mitten im Stadtverkehr der alten Industriemetropole Manchester soll eine Brücke abgerissen werden. Das Ziel ist natürlich, ihre Umgebung so wenig wie möglich in Mitleidenschaft zu ziehen. Auch für Experten eine gewaltige Herausforderung. (Senderinfo).

programme.title: The Demolition Man
programme.desc: Pineville, Lousiana. Die O. K. Allen Bridge, benannt nach einem einstigen Gouverneur des US-Bundestaats, soll für einen Neubau gesprengt werden. Brendan Moar zeigt, wie verzwickt ein solch gewaltiges Unterfangen ist. Das Timing der Operation und Sicherheitsaspekte müssen bis ins Detail untersucht und vorgeplant werden. Wie geht man ein solches Vorhaben in einer dicht besiedelten Stadt an? Auf dem Team, das die Aufgabe mit äußerster Präzision lösen muss, lastet eine enorme Verantwortung. (Senderinfo).

programme.title: Friday the 13th: The Final Chapter

The teens meet some locals: Tommy (Corey Feldman) and Trish (Kimberly Beck), as well as secretive hiker Rob (Erich Anderson). programme.title: Friday the 13th, Part VI: Jason Lives

To end his torment and achieve a level of closure, Tommy escapes from the hospital and heads to the graveyard where Jason is buried, intending to dig up the body and cremate it. But, before this total annihilation can occur, a freak electrical accident resurrects Jason from the dead, and the terror begins anew.

programme.title: Friday the 13th Part VII -- The New Blood

While deceitful Dr. Crews (Terry Kiser) tries to manipulate her abilities for his own ends, both physician and patient are in for a shock when Tina's powers unwittingly free camper-killer Jason Voorhees from his watery slumber.

programme.title: Friday the 13th

programme.desc: 生活科技大解密第14季:第7集.鋼是現今人類生活的重要原料，在澳洲的礦場會先鑽洞放置炸藥，再進行開採，之後壓碎礦石和分類篩選，最後經由專屬網絡運輸到全球各地。洪水氾濫會造成嚴重災害，因此荷蘭有一群防洪專家想建造最堅固的防波堤，建造了世上最大的波浪機，藉此測試防坡堤是否夠穩固。玻璃吊燈象徵著財富與權勢，手工雕花玻璃與金屬裝飾需花上數月時間才可完成，用浮石粉末進行打磨，再以黃銅冠當作基座。

programme.title: 生活科技大解密第14季:8
programme.desc: 生活科技大解密第14季:第8集.本集節目介紹牡蠣刀、LED燈和鑽石的製作。牡蠣刀的材質是碳鋼，壓製成形後，要用熔鹽加熱處理以使鋼硬化，冷卻後將刀片磨利，再裝上握把便完成。體育場的LED燈是先將68個LED燈嵌在燈板上，再將三塊燈板接合成為一組燈具，經過照明設計後，共安裝300組所構成，不只有照明功效，還能創造燈光效果，更是低耗能高效率的產品。人造鑽石，是先將鑽石種子洗淨，送入模擬鑽石生成條件的機器中，灌入氫氣和甲烷，並以高溫促使碳原子釋出，一點一滴結晶在鑽石種子上，長成後，經過拋光和切割便與天然鑽石無異。

programme.title: 河中巨怪第2季:5
programme.desc: 河中巨怪第2季:非洲水妖.傑洛米韋德重返25年前去過的剛果，想一探水妖傳說的虛實，上一回無功而返，這次他一心要捕獲一尾巨鯰。他冒著自身安危，來到世上最暴力的地方。經過數世紀的殖民剝削和種族衝突，剛果名列世上最貧窮和最危險的國家，人民缺乏物資，生活嚴峻，靠著捕魚勉強維生。他乘船往剛果河上游的朋加村出發，回想起當年在此罹患瘧疾的惡夢般經歷。在酋長殷圭瑪的協助下，主持人得以和當地漁夫交談，並得知更多關於巨鯰的消息。他試著在河中拉線佈餌，甚至不顧蚊子的猛烈攻擊，徹夜在釣竿前看著，日復一日，無奈就是毫無展獲，好景不常，酋長的兄弟去捕魚失蹤了，迷信的村民把矛頭指向他，更糟的是，暴風將至，再再增加捕鯰魚的危險程度。究竟主持人能否順利釣到巨鯰，請看節目見分曉。

programme.title: 河中巨怪第2季:6
programme.desc: 河中巨怪第2季:尼羅河尖吻鱸.主持人傑洛米韋德這次要挑戰世上最危險的捕魚點－東非大裂谷，尋找罕見的河中巨怪：尼羅河尖吻鱸。數千年來這裡的漁夫，為這非洲最大的淡水魚冒著性命安危，因為光一條魚就能養活整村人。這種魚是埋伏突襲掠食者，只要嘴巴吃得下，牠們什麼都吃。但是由於人類過度捕撈，這種巨魚變得更為稀有。主持人先來到烏干達的白尼羅河，發現尼羅河鱷魚橫行霸道，增添在這裡釣魚的危險性，加上又有暴風來襲，再再使得釣到巨魚的機會微乎其微。他於是轉往白尼羅河的源頭維多利亞湖，卻又發現這裡有產業規模的商業捕魚，只好北上到衣索匹亞釣魚，可惜未果，繼續往南到查莫湖，仍空手而歸。最後他來到莫契遜瀑布，究竟韋德能否如願以償，釣到傳說中的巨魚呢？

programme.title: 舊礦區新財路第1季:7
programme.desc: 舊礦區新財路:尋找礦藏.艾力克斯和凱文來到裴恩家的礦場，那裡位於歷史悠久的著名礦區科羅拉多州廷卡普旁。裴恩家的礦脈富含優質的銅、自然金和自然銀，他們開了科羅拉多岩石店，出售岩石標本，在網路上販售自製的珠寶和各種商品。他們在山上遇到極端天氣，冬季的情況非常誇張，一個冬季會遭遇15公尺深的雪，雪還壓壞了他們的房子，所以他們需要一個可以遮蔽惡劣天氣的地方好工作。艾力克斯和凱文冒著初到的雪季，替裴恩家的戶外廚房修建屋頂，還蓋了一個可以停放全地形車的單斜屋頂車棚，另外替女主人打造一間桑拿屋，還找來挖土機，把封住的礦坑也挖開了。裴恩家回報艾力克斯和凱文每人兩塊價值8千美元的富礦級樣本，並且送給他們的老婆各一條礦石項鍊。

Стелт – приключенски, екшън, фантастика . Компютърно управлявано бойно летателно средство претърпява авария, която разрушава първоначалната му програма и го насочва към Северна Корея в готовност да бомбардира вражеската територия. Екипът от трима асове на флотската авиация трябва на всяка цена да спре роботизирания самолет.

В капана на времето – мистери, трилър, ужаси . Семейство е на тропическа ваканция и открива, че уединеният плаж, на който се отпускат за няколко часа, по някакъв начин ги кара да остаряват бързо... превръщайки целия им живот в един-единствен ден.

Довереникът на кралицата – биографичен, исторически, комедия . Истинската история за удивителнотото приятелство между кралица Виктория и младия чиновник Абдул Карим, която предизвиква противоборство в кралския дом и изправя кралицата срещу двора. Филмът изследва с хумор въпросите за расата, религията, властта и фарса на монархията през призмата на едно изключително и дълбоко вълнуващо приятелство.

Доктор Дулитъл – фентъзи, семеен, приключенски . След смъртта на съпругата си д-р Джон Дулитъл, който може да говори с животни, решава да се скрие от света в имението си, обграден от домашните си любимци. За да помогне на умиращата кралица Виктория, му се налага да предприеме пътуване до мистериозен остров и да намери тайнствено лечебно дърво.

Ловци на духове – комедия, ужаси. Трима безработни парапсихолози неусетно се впускат да стават ловци на духове. Предстои им голямо приключение, подправено с редица комични ситуации, в опит да обуздаят обезумелите безгрижни духове, за да опазят сигурността на човечеството.

Момчето, което можеше да бъде крал – приключенски, семеен, фентъзи. Животът на британския ученик Алекс се променя завинаги, когато в ръцете му попада митичният меч Ескалибур. Той и приятелите му се впускат в епично приключение, за да се изправят срещу средновековния злодей Моргана и спасят света.
Смяна на местата – комедия. Снобски настроеният инвеститор и хитрият уличен измамник (Еди Мърфи) разменят позициите си в рамките на залог, направен от двама безсърдечни милионери.
Агент под прикритие – екшън, комедия, семеен . Бившият агент на ЦРУ Боб Хо трябва да се справя едновременно с ролите си на шпионин и баща, но мисията се оказва далеч по-трудна…и комична.

Нито звук: Ден първи (премиера) – трилър, ужаси, фантастика. Заклещена в Ню Йорк по време на извънземно нашествие, жена с неизлечима болест трябва да се спаси от жестоките същества, които използват усъвършенстван слух, за да ловуват жертвите си.
Аламо – драма, исторически, военен. По време на Тексаската революция от XIX век група обикновени мъже започват смъртоносна битка срещу многочислена мексиканска армия.

Торбалан – мистери, трилър, ужаси . В този хорър-трилър, плод на въображението на Стивън Кинг, две сестри — заедно с баща си, който е психотерапевт — се опитват да се справят със смъртта на майка си. Когато в дома им пристига отчаян пациент, той оставя след себе си ужасяващо същество, което се храни със страданията на жертвите си.

programme.desc: El Centroamérica Mercado Musical reunió a lo mejor de la música en Antigua Guatemala, rodeados de una ciudad llena de historia y latinidad Fabiola Roudha nos cuenta sobre sus planes y cómo se dio la colaboración con Daniela Romo.

programme.title: In Honor of Juneteenth 2025 | Blacktinidad
programme.desc: Join us for a Juneteenth episode where the hosts discuss the future of the holiday during the current climate, how we will soon be the next "ancestors" and keeping Black history alive for our loved ones.

programme.title: Hispanic Heritage Month: Latinos Changing The Narrative | Cultura Shock
programme.desc: For Hispanic Heritage Month, Cultura Shock is featuring Latinos who are taking space and telling their story.

programme.title: Angel Peaches: Old School Feminine Sass | Checkitow
programme.desc: Angel Peaches, aka Angel Jaurez, is the daughter of music artists, and by combining cumbia and new wave with her unique look and personality, she presents a nostalgic sense of sound and sensuality that is making people notice.

programme.title: Best of Your Annoying Prima | The Best of Jenny Lorenzo
programme.desc: You know that cousin who’s always doing too much for no reason? Laritza’s nonstop dramatics, mood swings, and main-character energy somehow turn every minor inconvenience into a full production, bro!

programme.title: Dan Mancina | Skate Tales
programme.desc: Even the huge physical and emotional blow of total sight loss didn't stop Dan Mancina from getting back on his skateboard. This is how he amazingly relearned to do what he loves.

programme.title: Lumati: Blending Western and Ancestral Medicine | Esencia: Latina Wellness
programme.desc: The visionary founders of Lumati, Geylin Castillo and David Perez are revolutionizing self-care by fusing cutting-edge science with time-honored ancestral practices.

programme.title: West Hollywood: Yamashiro | Foodie on the Go
programme.desc: Chiquis invites us to one of her favorite Japanese restaurants in LA: Yamashiro. In the 1920's, it was home to the 400 club welcoming celebrities from Hollywood's golden age. This Mansion is full of fresh ingredients and consistent quality.

programme.title: Goat Yoga | Jenicka's Journeys
programme.desc: Jenicka shares her journey toward a healthier, more balanced life and because laughter is an essential part of any wellness routine, she plans something extra fun: a yoga class with goats.

programme.title: Fashion and Flow | Ganadoras
programme.desc: This week on Ganadoras, we’re diving into the evolution of sports streetwear — how jerseys, sneakers, and sideline looks turned into everyday fashion.

programme.title: Objetivo Igualdad
programme.desc: "Objetivo Igualdad" pretende impulsar la igualdad real entre mujeres y hombres. Para ello, a través de reportajes y entrevistas se expondrán los problemas que generan la desigualdad y los estereotipos sexistas y sus posibles soluciones, se difundirán proyectos inspiradores.

programme.title: Agrosfera
programme.desc: Con vocación de servicio público y participación ciudadana, Agrosfera quiere llevar la actualidad del campo y el mar a agricultores, ganaderos, pescadores y habitantes del medio rural.

programme.title: Yo soy de formación profesional
programme.desc: La Formación Profesional se ha convertido en una alternativa para quien quiere incorporarse al mercado laboral. Para todas esas personas que buscan una preparación técnica, existen gran variedad de especialidades.

programme.title: Zoom tendencias

programme.title: Jardines con historia

programme.title: Live: MLB Central
programme.desc: MLB Network's first-ever regular-season morning show features hosts Robert Flores, Mark DeRosa and Lauren Shehadi reporting from Studio 21, named in honor of Hall of Famer and humanitarian Roberto Clemente. Updates and context on the latest news, extensive on-field highlights, and long-form conversations with guests, celebrities and insiders from around baseball are presented each weekday morning. Flores joined the network in 2016 as a host/reporter, DeRosa offers a unique outlook as a former player, and Shehadi honed crisp interviewing skills during three years of hosting MLB Network's "The Rundown.".

programme.title: Live: MLB Now

Host Brian Kenny discusses the issues and provides analysis, with a bent toward modern analytics to prove his points. The series also features interviews with personalities throughout the game, and viewer opinions are welcome as well via social media polls.

programme.title: Live: Intentional Talk
programme.desc: MLB Network's first-ever talk show is an open forum that features some talk and a lot of banter each weekday for host Kevin Millar, who discusses with special guests what's hot and what's not in and around the national pastime. He also runs out of the baseline at times by welcoming guests from the worlds of entertainment and pop culture to talk about trending topics in those arenas. Millar gained fame as a member of the 2004 world champion Boston Red Sox, and since he retired from the diamond his knowledge of the game and warm, affable personality have vaulted him into a lengthy career in the media.

programme.title: Trackmasters
programme.desc: After the 24-hour race was over we left the Nürburgring and moved to Büren, Germany, where the Raeder Motorsport company is based. They are famous for front-wheel drives with a great performance that put a lot of horsepower to the track.

programme.title: Trackmasters
programme.desc: The roaring sounds of engines and exhausts usually dominate the Nürburgring, but we focused on something a bit quieter this time. How about taking part in a 15 mile bike ride around the ring, or perhaps a 16 mile run?

programme.title: Artega GT
programme.desc: From 2006 to 2012 the German company Artega produced their GT sports car model. Thanks to the know-how of a former Porsche and BMW manager the Artega GT was able to be manufactured in a small series.

programme.title: Motorstories
programme.desc: Frank Slopianka is a racing junkie and constantly takes part in such events. US car fans Kati and Patrick join him for the Race 61, a rock and race festival in Finowfurt near Berlin. There Frank and and his Dragster Camaro take part in the 1/8 mile race.

programme.title: Motorstories
programme.sub-title: Mercedes 280 SE goes America - French Riviera
programme.desc: German entrepeneur Tillmann Miritz loves vintage cars and has a dream: driving through the USA in his Mercedes Cabriolet 280 SE 3.5. He drives along the picturesque French Riviera and visits a classic car collector before his 280 gets shipped.

programme.title: Motorstories
programme.sub-title: Mercedes 280 SE goes America - New York
programme.desc: Tillmann starts his dream journey in New York, the city that never sleeps. With his Mercedes 280 SE convertible he visits the legendary classic car dealer Eliot Cuker who made his fortune with his passion for old cars.

programme.title: Arden AJ23
programme.desc: A Jaguar that is able to terrify the world alone with its roar. This Jaguar F-Type R tuned by Arden is a real bad boy. Already in the series production configuration, the F-Type R Coupe is a dream car that can really bite but this Jaguar which has been upgraded from Arden, now calls itself "AJ23“ and is more powerful, louder and more aggressive than any of his brothers.

programme.title: Jaguar XJR
programme.desc: The highlight of the XJR lies beneath the hood: all of Jaguar's top models are equipped with the 5-liter V8 compressor engine that delivers 550 HP in this sports sedan.

programme.title: Supercars
programme.desc: We took the Mercedes AMG SLS GT to an airfield and the Porsche 911 Turbo S to the racetrack in order to see these sporty driving machines in action and test their performance. In addition: the Audi R8 4.0 TFSI's innovative lighting technology.

programme.title: Supercars
programme.desc: Jaguar found their way back to the world of sports cars. The F-Type doesn't just look good, it's got what it takes, and the car is able to take on the competition like the BMW Z4. We also took a closer look at two other competitors, the Porsche Boxster S and Nissan's 370 Z.

programme.title: Supercars
programme.desc: For more than 60 years the Corvette has been the embodiment of the American sports car. Also: the Ford Mustang GT, an iconic model with a V8 engine at the price of a Volkswagen Passat. And: the Chevrolet Camaro, another classic from the land where cylinder capacity is still valued a lot.

programme.title: Lamborghini Huracan by O.CT
programme.desc: A lot of power thanks to a compressor. This optimized O.CT Lamborghini Huracán delivers over 800 horse power to get the blood flowing.

programme.title: Morgan ARP4
programme.desc: Since 1950, the exhilarating Morgan +4 has been the mainstay of Morgan production. The ARP4 is the latest addition to the +4 family and strictly limited to a run of 50.

programme.title: Beradino
programme.desc: A „bella macchina“, a beautiful car - but not designed by masters like Bertone or Pininfarina. Johannes Paulussen from Neuss in Germany built the Beradino by hand.

programme.title: 4x4
programme.desc: The Jaguar XF-S is supposed to put pressure on BMW, Audi and the other competitors in the business class segment. Volvo take a different approach. Their S90 is captivating due to its Scandinavian design and economical four-cylinder engines.

programme.title: 4x4
programme.desc: BMW offers the X2 as a compact hipster SUV for young people. The DS 7 Crossback, on the other hand, wants to convey the French lifestyle. And Jaguar's E-Pace enters the market as a smaller version of the F-Pace.

programme.title: 4x4
programme.desc: With the compact SUV Velar, Range Rover attempts to reach a broader audience. Jeep relies on the tried and tested: the design of the Wrangler has remained almost the same for more than 60 years. Also: the Volvo XC60 and the Ford Edge.

programme.title: 4x4
programme.desc: The Mercedes Sprinter still is one of the most popular commercial vehicles. For its third generation, the brand chose to have it manufactured in Poland. Before, this iconic van shared its production line with Volkswagen's Crafter.

programme.title: 4x4
programme.desc: Porsche quits the diesel business. Hybrids such as the Cayenne E-Hybrid are expected to become their focus of attention. Also: taking the BMW X4 on tour around Spartanburg, USA. And: mountain climbing with the Volkswagen Touareg in Austria.

programme.title: Mitsubishi Lancer Evo 10
programme.desc: The ice course on Lungauring, the Mitsubishi Lancer Evo 10 in winter training. Twelve participants in six Evos were taught the art of drifting with a four-wheel drive car. We accompanied a student on his first drifting experience.

programme.title: Joseph Stalin's ZIS 110
programme.desc: James Bond still didn't have a license to kill, when this representative Russian vehicle called ZIS 110 rolled off the production line in 1949. The 110 was developed by reverse engineering a 1942 Packard Super Eight.

programme.title: Car History
programme.desc: Es ist der zweitgrößte Automobil-Hersteller der Welt, die Volkswagen AG. Doch Anfang der Siebziger Jahre steckt VW in einer Krise. VW hat keine Antwort auf den Ölpreisschock und keinen Nachfolger für den Käfer. Erst mit den Autos der neuen Generation Passat und Golf kommt das Werk auf die Überholspur zurück. (Senderinfo).

programme.desc: 1990 startet der schnellste Markenpokal der Welt in seine erste Saison: der Porsche Carrera Cup. Das 911 Carrera 2 Cup Coupé mit Sechszylinder-Boxermotor mit 265 PS und dazu 35 heißblütige und ehrgeizige Rennfahrer – fertig war der schärfste Renncocktail der Welt. (Senderinfo).

programme.title: Nos héros du quotidien
programme.desc: Sur la route, quatre accidents mortels sur dix sont dus à une vitesse excessive. En mer, la démocratisation des scooters a généré une hausse du nombre d'accidents. Les forces de police et les gendarmes ont développé de nouveaux moyens d'intervention afin de lutter contre la délinquance des conducteurs irrespectueux.

programme.title: 六樓后座
programme.desc: Candy、Karena、Wing、Jean-Leo和美顏寶。 偶然遇上一年租約的超荀盤, 決定租下這六樓后座。 六人愛玩truth or dare, 全部放下面具, 在此后座沒有秘密。新年新氣象, 六人揚言一年後要做到定下的目標, 誰做不到就食屎, 包租婆作證。最後兩個月, Karena 步向成功, 其他人才體會事情的可怕和認真。起舞吧!一支可歌可泣可笑可愛的青春之舞, 我們nothing to lose...

programme.title: 馬達．蓮娜
programme.desc: 故事發生在初春的澳門。40多歲, 失婚、不善言辭的馬達 (張繼聰 飾) 居住在準備遷拆的老房子, 他患有嚴重的失眠症, 無法入睡的他通過當夜間的士司機來排解失眠的痛苦。 一天晚上馬達接上了早上當酒樓侍應, 晚上當陪酒女郎的蓮娜 (周秀娜 飾), 兩人因誤會成為朋友, 馬達更當上了蓮娜上下班的專用司機。蓮娜的出現令馬達的生活多了一點色彩, 甚至開始認為自己走出失婚的傷痛。在澳門, 蓮娜是寂寞的, 身邊的同事都不喜歡她, 認為她就是一個很愛錢, 不擇手段的錶子, 因為她總是用上天賜予的性感身材去換取特殊待遇。 蓮娜心知馬達的愛意, 只是蓮娜背後埋藏著一段未能釋懷的過去......

programme.title: 柔道龍虎榜
programme.desc: 歌廳經理兼樂隊領班司徒寶, 曾是一名柔道高手, 數年前不知何故放棄柔道. 變得沉淪墮落, 嗜賭酗酒, 直至好戰尚武的皮褸 Tony 慕名到來挑戰; 宿敵辣手阿岡又因當年一場未完的比賽找上門來; 還有, 年邁的鄭師傅帶著痴呆兒子阿正, 為拯救破落道場來請求幫助... 歌廳頓時變成一眾柔道高手的「較技場」, 司徒寶的鬥心再度燃起

programme.title: 爆谷電影現場 第283集
programme.desc: 爆谷獨有電影大師組成的幕後精英超強班底, 每集全天候報導電影拍攝現場精彩過程, 獨家訪問, 第一次曝光電影片段。爆谷台瞭解任何一部電影的誕生, 都是幕前幕後眾多精英心血與智慧的結晶, 所以節目會以尋常角度看待所有工作人員如何齊心協力建造屬於他們自己的「夢工廠」。

programme.title: 失戀急讓
programme.desc: 勤奮半生的地產經紀項少龍, 向女友求婚, 卻因婚房太小而遭拒絕。在苦苦思量賺錢大計之時, 一個名為「無雙臺」的夢幻豪宅, 業主低價放盤。因緣際會, 項少龍身邊有兩位擁有一點資金的朋友, 他忽發奇想: 何不一起購下「無雙臺」炒賣?豈料, 一些讓他們意想不到的隱情接踵而至......

programme.title: 暴瘋語
programme.desc: 三年前, 范國生 (劉青雲 飾) 精神分裂症病發, 殺害妻子方慧玲 (葉璇 飾) 後自殺不遂, 被警方拘捕後判入精神病院作無限期治療。周明傑 (黃曉明 飾) 成為范國生的主診醫生, 經過三年的治療後, 他認為范國生已經康復, 力排眾議, 堅決讓范國生出院。可惜重投社會後的范國生受盡歧視, 再次步向崩潰邊緣, 一時衝動下, 錯手將一名癮君子殺害, 走投無路, 范國生只能向周明傑求助。周明傑怕事件被揭發後毀了自己的事業, 決定助范國生潛逃, 同時為了隱瞞真相飽受傳媒與輿論的壓力。風口浪尖上, 范國生竟再次找上周明傑, 但此刻的范國生已變得瘋狂。為了彌補自己造成的錯誤, 周明傑決定秘密為范國生進行治療, 過程中兩人間的角力升級, 周明傑又能否拯救已全面失控的范國生呢?

programme.title: 假面之夜
programme.desc: 警視廳收到匿名來信, 預告殺人犯將於除夕「假面之夜」化裝舞會中現身, 而派對的地點正是刑警新田浩介 (木村拓哉飾) 曾當臥底的五星級酒店!為了能在500個蒙面嫌疑犯中找出真兇, 新田再次披上酒店制服, 夥拍舊拍檔酒店服務員山岸尚美 (長澤正美飾) , 誓要在24小時內鎖定兇徒!面對各色各樣的面具, 二人找不到絲毫線索, 但身份不明的可疑人士卻愈來愈多......到底殺人動機是什麼, 告密者又是誰?時間一分一秒地倒數著, 新田和尚美兩人又能否找到戴著「假面」的殺人犯, 並揭開假面下隱藏的真相?

programme.title: 爆谷電影現場 第285集
programme.desc: 爆谷獨有電影大師組成的幕後精英超強班底, 每集全天候報導電影拍攝現場精彩過程, 獨家訪問, 第一次曝光電影片段。爆谷台瞭解任何一部電影的誕生, 都是幕前幕後眾多精英心血與智慧的結晶, 所以節目會以尋常角度看待所有工作人員如何齊心協力建造屬於他們自己的「夢工廠」。

programme.title: 千萬別開門
programme.desc: 剛搬進新屋的秀賢上網買了二手洗衣機, 收到貨品才發現洗衣機是壞的, 完全無法使用。秀賢意識到自己被騙, 就到賣家的網上帳戶留言, 稱對方為騙子, 警告其他人不要落入騙財陷阱, 沒想到此舉引發了兇徒殺機, 令自己成為犯罪目標!後來, 秀賢聯同周刑警追蹤到疑犯住處, 竟然在屋內發現一具屍體......

programme.title: 六樓后座
programme.desc: Candy、Karena、Wing、Jean-Leo和美顏寶。 偶然遇上一年租約的超荀盤, 決定租下這六樓后座。 六人愛玩truth or dare, 全部放下面具, 在此后座沒有秘密。新年新氣象, 六人揚言一年後要做到定下的目標, 誰做不到就食屎, 包租婆作證。最後兩個月, Karena 步向成功, 其他人才體會事情的可怕和認真。起舞吧!一支可歌可泣可笑可愛的青春之舞, 我們nothing to lose...

programme.title: 馬達．蓮娜
programme.desc: 故事發生在初春的澳門。40多歲, 失婚、不善言辭的馬達 (張繼聰 飾) 居住在準備遷拆的老房子, 他患有嚴重的失眠症, 無法入睡的他通過當夜間的士司機來排解失眠的痛苦。 一天晚上馬達接上了早上當酒樓侍應, 晚上當陪酒女郎的蓮娜 (周秀娜 飾), 兩人因誤會成為朋友, 馬達更當上了蓮娜上下班的專用司機。蓮娜的出現令馬達的生活多了一點色彩, 甚至開始認為自己走出失婚的傷痛。在澳門, 蓮娜是寂寞的, 身邊的同事都不喜歡她, 認為她就是一個很愛錢, 不擇手段的錶子, 因為她總是用上天賜予的性感身材去換取特殊待遇。 蓮娜心知馬達的愛意, 只是蓮娜背後埋藏著一段未能釋懷的過去......

programme.title: 柔道龍虎榜
programme.desc: 歌廳經理兼樂隊領班司徒寶, 曾是一名柔道高手, 數年前不知何故放棄柔道. 變得沉淪墮落, 嗜賭酗酒, 直至好戰尚武的皮褸 Tony 慕名到來挑戰; 宿敵辣手阿岡又因當年一場未完的比賽找上門來; 還有, 年邁的鄭師傅帶著痴呆兒子阿正, 為拯救破落道場來請求幫助... 歌廳頓時變成一眾柔道高手的「較技場」, 司徒寶的鬥心再度燃起

programme.title: 爆谷電影現場 第283集
programme.desc: 爆谷獨有電影大師組成的幕後精英超強班底, 每集全天候報導電影拍攝現場精彩過程, 獨家訪問, 第一次曝光電影片段。爆谷台瞭解任何一部電影的誕生, 都是幕前幕後眾多精英心血與智慧的結晶, 所以節目會以尋常角度看待所有工作人員如何齊心協力建造屬於他們自己的「夢工廠」。

programme.title: 失戀急讓
programme.desc: 勤奮半生的地產經紀項少龍, 向女友求婚, 卻因婚房太小而遭拒絕。在苦苦思量賺錢大計之時, 一個名為「無雙臺」的夢幻豪宅, 業主低價放盤。因緣際會, 項少龍身邊有兩位擁有一點資金的朋友, 他忽發奇想: 何不一起購下「無雙臺」炒賣?豈料, 一些讓他們意想不到的隱情接踵而至......

programme.title: 暴瘋語
programme.desc: 三年前, 范國生 (劉青雲 飾) 精神分裂症病發, 殺害妻子方慧玲 (葉璇 飾) 後自殺不遂, 被警方拘捕後判入精神病院作無限期治療。周明傑 (黃曉明 飾) 成為范國生的主診醫生, 經過三年的治療後, 他認為范國生已經康復, 力排眾議, 堅決讓范國生出院。可惜重投社會後的范國生受盡歧視, 再次步向崩潰邊緣, 一時衝動下, 錯手將一名癮君子殺害, 走投無路, 范國生只能向周明傑求助。周明傑怕事件被揭發後毀了自己的事業, 決定助范國生潛逃, 同時為了隱瞞真相飽受傳媒與輿論的壓力。風口浪尖上, 范國生竟再次找上周明傑, 但此刻的范國生已變得瘋狂。為了彌補自己造成的錯誤, 周明傑決定秘密為范國生進行治療, 過程中兩人間的角力升級, 周明傑又能否拯救已全面失控的范國生呢?

programme.title: 假面之夜
programme.desc: 警視廳收到匿名來信, 預告殺人犯將於除夕「假面之夜」化裝舞會中現身, 而派對的地點正是刑警新田浩介 (木村拓哉飾) 曾當臥底的五星級酒店!為了能在500個蒙面嫌疑犯中找出真兇, 新田再次披上酒店制服, 夥拍舊拍檔酒店服務員山岸尚美 (長澤正美飾) , 誓要在24小時內鎖定兇徒!面對各色各樣的面具, 二人找不到絲毫線索, 但身份不明的可疑人士卻愈來愈多......到底殺人動機是什麼, 告密者又是誰?時間一分一秒地倒數著, 新田和尚美兩人又能否找到戴著「假面」的殺人犯, 並揭開假面下隱藏的真相?

programme.title: 爆谷電影現場 第285集
programme.desc: 爆谷獨有電影大師組成的幕後精英超強班底, 每集全天候報導電影拍攝現場精彩過程, 獨家訪問, 第一次曝光電影片段。爆谷台瞭解任何一部電影的誕生, 都是幕前幕後眾多精英心血與智慧的結晶, 所以節目會以尋常角度看待所有工作人員如何齊心協力建造屬於他們自己的「夢工廠」。

programme.title: 千萬別開門
programme.desc: 剛搬進新屋的秀賢上網買了二手洗衣機, 收到貨品才發現洗衣機是壞的, 完全無法使用。秀賢意識到自己被騙, 就到賣家的網上帳戶留言, 稱對方為騙子, 警告其他人不要落入騙財陷阱, 沒想到此舉引發了兇徒殺機, 令自己成為犯罪目標!後來, 秀賢聯同周刑警追蹤到疑犯住處, 竟然在屋內發現一具屍體......

programme.title: Peppa Pig

programme.title: PAW Patrol
programme.desc: Having made a big blunder in a recent rescue, Zuma trades in his usual chill attitude and becomes a super serious pup; his new persona gets tested when an actual pirate arrives, bent on hidden treasure and willing to destroy things to get it!

programme.title: PAW Patrol

One Piece
programme.sub-title: Let's Go and Meet Master Cat Viper!
programme.desc: There's only one key to finding out what happened to Sanji - and Luffy and the others make their way towards finding out more about their friend's disappearance, but on their way the indigenous fauna give them trouble!

programme.title: One Piece
programme.sub-title: Luffy's Decision! Sanji on the Brink of Quitting!
programme.desc: Luffy hatches a plan to help Sanji, but he'll have to go alone to avoid an all-out war with Big Mom. Meanwhile, Kin'emon and Kanjuro finally arrive at Zou, unwittingly setting the stage for the Minks' thirst for revenge!

programme.title: One Piece
programme.sub-title: A Volatile Situation! The Dog and the Cat and the Samurai!
programme.desc: The samurai have landed! And they make their way into the country of Zou unaware of the welcome they will receive by the Minks!

programme.title: One Piece
programme.sub-title: The Third One! Raizo of the Mist, the Ninja, Appears!
programme.desc: Revelations abound as the true nature of the Wano clan and their relationship with the Minks is revealed! Momonosuke's role is greater than any had imagined! But even more shocking - the visage of Raizo the Ninja!

programme.title: One Piece
programme.sub-title: A Red Stone! A Guide to the One Piece!
programme.desc: The mysteries of ninjutsu enthrall the Straw Hats as Raizo, the implausible ninja, makes his true powers known! Meanwhile, a mysterious artifact points the way towards the end of the Grand Line!

programme.title: One Piece
programme.sub-title: The Secret of the Land of Wano! The Kozuki Family and the Ponegliffs!
programme.desc: The mystery of the Ponegliffs is revealed - their true significance, and the story of their creation, leads closer to the Straw Hats than they might have imagined!

programme.title: One Piece
programme.sub-title: A Vow Between Two Men! Luffy and Kozuki Momonosuke!
programme.desc: More mysteries of the Kozuki Clan are revealed - and the samurai propose an alliance to help topple Kaido! But Luffy's response will shock the crew... and force the young daimyo to take responsibility!

programme.title: One Piece
programme.sub-title: The Legendary Journey! The Dog and the Cat and the Pirate King!
programme.desc: Dogstorm and Cat Viper share their story of being on the journey with Oden and Roger but are interrupted by Nami who is concerned about the sea route. Meanwhile, Jack is plotting to bring down the Mokomo Dukedom again!

programme.title: One Piece
programme.sub-title: The Nightmare Returns! The Invincible Jack's Fierce Attack!
programme.desc: The plans are set! The Straw Hats divide and conquer, one group heading to save Sanji, the others to the Land of Wano! But in the final moments before their departure, the tremendous elephant island begins to quake!

programme.title: One Piece
programme.sub-title: A Battle to Defend Zou! Luffy and Zunesha!
programme.desc: After being aggressively attacked by Jack's fleet, the monstrous Zunesha comes to life and beckons to those on its back! But can the Straw Hats understand its cry? And realize in time what the elephant island needs from them?

programme.title: One Piece
programme.sub-title: Save Zunesha! The Straw Hat's Rescue Operation!
programme.desc: With the skirmish with Jack now over, the Straw Hats move on to trying to bandage the great elephant's wounds! But just as the whole island puts the plan into action, unseen danger lurks on horizon!

programme.title: One Piece
programme.sub-title: Saying Goodbye and Descending from the Elephant! Setting Out to Take Back Sanji!
programme.desc: The Straw Hats and the others split up into four teams, each on different missions! Some from the Mink Tribe insist on leaving with Luffy's team! Meanwhile, Usopp makes a weapon for Nami that seems to work like magic!

programme.title: One Piece
programme.sub-title: To the Reverie! Princess Vivi and Princess Shirahoshi!
programme.desc: Luffy's team sets out from Zou on their way to win back Sanji! But they didn't realize there is one more crewmember than they have bargained for!

programme.title: One Piece
programme.sub-title: To the Reverie! Rebecca and the Sakura Kingdom!
programme.desc: Carrot stows away! And settles in with the Straw Hats as they make their way to rescue Sanji! Meanwhile, in the Sakura Kingdom, Dalton and Kureha are getting ready for the Reverie so as their former enemy in his newly-built kingdom…

programme.title: JoJo's Bizarre Adventure: The Pillar Man
programme.desc: In search of the mysterious Pillar Man, Joseph arrives in Mexico to promising news but deadly resistance. Now the German army’s thirst for power may have awakened an unstoppable power—even for Joseph.

programme.title: JoJo's Bizarre Adventure: JoJo vs. The Ultimate Lifeform
programme.desc: Trading blows with Santviento, Joseph employs his usual wit, but the jokes fall as flat as the Hamon. Stroheim surprises as he sheds light on the lethal Pillar Men, leaving Joseph hanging in more ways than one.

programme.title: JoJo's Bizarre Adventure: Ultimate Warriors from Ancient Times
programme.desc: Joseph and Speedwagon travel to Rome to meet another Hamon wielder, Caesar Zeppeli, who takes them to the enigmatic Pillar Men. While Joseph and Caesar clash, they arrive to find a grim awakening.

programme.title: JoJo's Bizarre Adventure: A Hero's Proof
programme.desc: Caesar confronts Wamuu and the other Pillar Men, but falters, clearing the way for Joseph. But anxiety replaces audacity as Joseph’s plan invites a presumable death sentence.

programme.title: JoJo's Bizarre Adventure
programme.desc: In mysterious Venice, Joseph and Caesar begin training under the equally enigmatic Lisa Lisa. Let the Hamon “hell” begin!

programme.title: JoJo's Bizarre Adventure
programme.desc: Under Lisa Lisa’s tutelage, Joseph and Caesar must endure their final test. But while Caesar hones his skills, Joseph is stunned by an ancient and unexpected foe.

programme.title: JoJo's Bizarre Adventure
programme.desc: Joseph returns to Lisa Lisa, unaware of the bizarre stowaway he has delivered. A possessed confidant then attacks, ultimately sending the crew to Switzerland, where another revelation awaits.

programme.title: JoJo's Bizarre Adventure: A Race Toward the Brink
programme.desc: Stroheim is back from the brink, now as a cyborg designed to secure the great Red Stone. Kars, however, is not willing to concede and wages war, even as the stone hurtles toward an alpine cliff.

programme.title: JoJo's Bizarre Adventure
programme.desc: Lisa Lisa paints a picture of honor when she reveals Caesar’s tragic past to Joseph. Meanwhile, in the face of certain danger, Caesar enters into a solitary battle to avenge his father.

programme.title: JoJo's Bizarre Adventure
programme.desc: Inside a shadowy St. Moritz hotel, danger leaves Joseph and Lisa Lisa no time to mourn as they follow a bloody trail to Wamuu and Kars. Luckily, Lisa Lisa manages to strike a deal—but, of course, with one condition.

programme.title: JoJo's Bizarre Adventure
programme.desc: Joseph and Wamuu finally face off in an equestrian one-on-one. But will Joseph’s adroit attacks and weapon-grasping prowess be enough to keep Wamuu’s millennia-old pride in check?

programme.title: JoJo's Bizarre Adventure: The Warrior of Wind
programme.desc: When the battle between Wamuu and Joseph comes to a head, the surprising confessions aren’t far behind. Now the final hour has come for Lisa Lisa and Kars—a fighter very different from his fellow Pillar Men.

programme.title: JoJo's Bizarre Adventure: The Ties that Bind JoJo
programme.desc: With Lisa Lisa’s life on the line, Joseph must deceive the deceiver. Joining Joseph, Stroheim and Speedwagon arrive at the battlefield, where a family tragedy threatens to doom the world to a hopeless future.

programme.title: JoJo's Bizarre Adventure: The Birth of a Superbeing
programme.desc: Having seized the Red Stone and the mask, Kars has become the Ultimate Being. Now the seemingly invincible entity has his sights solely on Joseph who, fleeing, has one final trick up his sleeve.

programme.title: JoJo's Bizarre Adventure: The Ascendant One
programme.desc: Deep within a volcano’s molten lava, Kars contemplates a comeback. But with the Red Stone’s power unleashed, both warriors are launched into the stratosphere of the unknown.

programme.title: JoJo's Bizarre Adventure: The Man Possessed by an Evil Spirit
programme.sub-title: The Man Possessed by an Evil Spirit
programme.desc: Japan, 1987. Jotaro Kujo, a descendant of the Joestar family, is in prison and claims he is being possessed by an evil spirit. His grandfather, Joseph Joestar, immediately departs for Japan, where he must reveal the family's terrible secret.

programme.title: JoJo's Bizarre Adventure: Who Will Be the Judge!?
programme.desc: Jotaro returns to his normal life while keeping his "Stand" power a secret. But on the way to school one day he meets a new transfer student named Noriaki Kakyoin and sustains a strange injury.

programme.title: JoJo's Bizarre Adventure: The Curse of DIO
programme.desc: Jotaro defeats Kakyoin with his Stand power, but as he attempts to glean information from his adversary about DIO, Joseph notices a sinister connection.

programme.title: JoJo's Bizarre Adventure: Tower of Grey
programme.desc: The Joestars must defeat DIO within 50 days or Holly's life is forfeit. With no time to lose, they head for Egypt where DIO is thought to be hiding but end up encountering a new threat along the way.

programme.title: JoJo's Bizarre Adventure: Silver Chariot
programme.desc: Jotaro and his comrades are attacked by Polnareff, an assassin with a Stand called "Silver Chariot" that is capable of lightning-fast swordplay. It falls to Avdol to face down the threat using "Magician's Red."

programme.title: JoJo's Bizarre Adventure: Dark Blue Moon
programme.desc: Jotaro welcomes a new member to the team and the group leaves for Singapore by ship. Along the way, a young stowaway is found and Jotaro comes under attack, but is the child the source of this latest evil?

programme.title: JoJo's Bizarre Adventure: Strength
programme.desc: Jotaro’s group is rescued when they spot a giant cargo ship, but they soon find that the only occupant is a strange orangutan. Curious, they begin to explore the ship and solve its mysteries.

programme.title: JoJo's Bizarre Adventure
programme.desc: Jotaro and his companions finally make it to a hotel in Singapore, but soon Polnareff falls into a trap set by a dangerous and brutal enemy.

programme.title: JoJo's Bizarre Adventure: Yellow Temperance
programme.desc: Joseph uses his Stand to generate a spirit message from a TV, only to receive a warning claiming that Kakyoin is a traitor. Meanwhile, Jotaro, Ann and Kakyoin are out exploring Singapore when Kakyoin begins acting strangely.

programme.title: JoJo's Bizarre Adventure
programme.desc: The Joestars' group arrives in India, where Polnareff is attacked by a Stand only visible through a mirror. As terrifying as it is, the Stand could also be related to his sister's murder.

programme.title: JoJo's Bizarre Adventure: The Emperor and the Hanged Man Part 2
programme.sub-title: The Emperor and the Hanged Man Part 2
programme.desc: When Avdol is struck down defending Polnareff, the Frenchman goes into a state of shock, leaving him vulnerable. That is when "Hanged Man," Centerfold's Stand, begins its most furious attack.

programme.title: JoJo's Bizarre Adventure: The Empress
programme.desc: Jotaro and the others next head toward Varanasi. On their way there, Joseph realizes his arm is quite swollen. At first, it doesn't bother him much, but the bigger it gets, the creepier it looks.

programme.title: JoJo's Bizarre Adventure: Wheel of Fortune
programme.desc: Jotaro and his group head toward Pakistan by car. Polnareff is behind the wheel on a dangerous mountain road when a mysterious vehicle starts impeding their progress.

programme.title: JoJo's Bizarre Adventure: Justice Part 1
programme.desc: After surviving another attack, Jotaro and his team make it to Pakistan, where they stop at an inn to rest. The village around the inn, however, is quiet, and its inhabitants rather odd.

programme.title: Mission Adventure
programme.desc: In „Mission Adventure“ stellt Moderator Jan Stecker Menschen mit außergewöhnlichen Berufen vor, die stark vom herkömmlichen 0815 Büro-Job abweichen. So schaut er den Flying Doctors bei ihrer Arbeit im australischen Outback zu, stellt sich der Frage, warum die Führerscheinprüfung in Shanghai im Vergleich zu anderen so schwer ist und, was man zum Überleben auf einer einsamen Insel benötigt.

programme.title: Akrobatische Haie: Die spektakulärsten Bilder
programme.desc: Wenn Haie auf Beute-Jagd gehen, kann es zu spektakulären Sprüngen kommen. Die Fotografen Chris Fallows und Jeff Kurr machen seit über 20 Jahren Aufnahmen von Weißen Haien. Einen besonderen Schwerpunkt legen die beiden dabei auf die Jagdtechniken und die akrobatischen Sprünge, die diese Raubtiere beim Beutefang ausführen können.

programme.title: Weißer Hai vs. Tigerhai
programme.desc: Zwei Giganten der Meere treffen aufeinander: Der majestätische Weiße Hai und der kraftvolle Tigerhai gehören zu den eindrucksvollsten Räubern des Ozeans und begegnen sich nur in Ausnahmefällen. Die Doku begleitet Forscher und Fotografen, die genau solch einen seltenen Moment festhalten konnten. Dabei geraten sie auch „Deep Blue“ vor die Linse – ein legendäres Exemplar, das als einer der größten We

programme.title: Air Jaws: Sprungparade der Weißen Haie
Weißer Hai vs. Megalodon
programme.desc: Ein urzeitlicher Gigant wirft bis heute Fragen auf: Der Megalodon beherrschte einst die Meere – dann verschwand er. In dieser Doku gehen Forschende Hinweisen nach, die auf einen überraschenden Rivalen deuten: den Weißen Hai. Neue Erkenntnisse und spektakuläre Rekonstruktionen sollen klären, ob der heutige Spitzenräuber tatsächlich zum Untergang des prähistorischen Monsters beitrug.

programme.title: Bear vs. Sharks – Ausgesetzt im Bermuda-Dreieck
programme.desc: Im berüchtigten Bermuda-Dreieck stellt sich Bear Grylls einer der gefährlichsten Hai-Populationen der Welt. Statt sicherer Käfige setzt er auf direkte Konfrontation – mitten im offenen Ozean. Um ihre Jagd- und Fressreaktionen zu erleben, lockt er die Tiere an und begibt sich anschließend selbst ins Wasser...

programme.title: Clash of Killers – Begegnung der Giganten
programme.desc: Zwei der schnellsten und mächtigsten Haiarten teilen sich normalerweise kein Jagdrevier – doch vor Neuseeland könnte sich das ändern. Meeresbiologe Riley Elliott vermutet, dass sich dort die Wege von Weißen Haien und Makohaien kreuzen. Gemeinsam mit seinem Team wagt er sich in ein gefährliches Seegebiet, sammelt Daten, verfolgt Bewegungsmuster und sucht nach Beweisen für ein seltenes Aufeinandertr

programme.title: Hai vs. Boot
programme.desc: Immer häufiger tauchen Clips auf, in denen Haie Jagd auf Motorboote, Schlauchboote oder kleine Yachten zu machen scheinen. Meeresforscher Mike Heithaus und Sara Casareto gehen den rätselhaften Attacken nach. Sie analysieren Aufnahmen, sammeln Daten vor Ort und beobachten die Tiere in freier Wildbahn.

programme.title: Haie gegen den Rest der Welt
programme.desc: Mit durchschnittlich zehn getöteten Menschen pro Jahr stellen Haiangriffe eine äußerst geringe Gefahr dar. Wer gebissen wird, sieht das sicher anders. Hier gibt es rare Bildaufnahmen davon. Zumeist aber grandiose Jagdszenen auf ihre natürliche Beute.

programme.title: Killer of the Great White
programme.desc: Vor Südafrikas Küsten spielt sich ein schockierendes Naturrätsel ab: Immer häufiger treiben tote Weiße Haie ans Ufer – verstümmelt und ohne klaren Täter. Meeresbiologin Alison Towner nimmt die Spur auf und untersucht, wer den einstigen Herrscher der Meere verdrängt hat.

programme.title: Shark vs. Predator
programme.desc: Im Meer gibt es keinen unangefochtenen Herrscher – auch Haie nicht. Die Doku zeigt seltene und spektakuläre Szenen, in denen die gefürchteten Jäger plötzlich selbst zu Opfern werden. Ob größere Meeresgiganten, Rivalen oder überraschende Gegner: Hier wird deutlich, dass selbst die stärksten Räuber der Ozeane ständig ums Überleben kämpfen.

programme.title: Das Rätsel der toten Haie
programme.desc: Vor Australiens Westküste tauchen immer wieder tote Haie auf – ohne sichtbare Verletzungen, ohne klare Spur. Etwas tötet die Raubfische, doch was? Abenteurer und Tierforscher Forrest Galante geht dem mysteriösen Phänomen nach, untersucht die Kadaver, spricht mit Experten und verfolgt ungewöhnliche Theorien. Könnten hochgiftige Seeschlangen hinter den rätselhaften Todesfällen stecken?

programme.title: Makohaie vor Kalifornien
programme.desc: Vor der Küste Kaliforniens gehen Wissenschaftler und Kamerateams auf Forschungsreise, um den Mako-Hai zu untersuchen – einen der schnellsten Raubfische der Ozeane, der selbst den Weißen Haien das Revier streitig macht. Mithilfe modernster Technik analysieren sie sein Jagdverhalten, seine Bewegungen und seine außergewöhnlichen Fähigkeiten.

programme.title: CSI: Miami

Ist er „Der Sündenbock“ für einen anderen Täter? Zur gleichen Zeit untersucht Calleigh (Emily Procter) den Mord an einem deutschen Touristen.

programme.title: CSI: Miami
programme.desc: In einem Altenheim wird eine 81-Jährige ermordet. War’s einer der Lover der lebenslustigen Dame? \n\nIm zweiten Fall stößt ein Mann in einem leer stehenden Haus auf eine Drogenküche und stirbt an giftigen Dämpfen, die er dort eingeatmet hat. Der Hausbesitzer, Arzt und Unternehmer Dr. James Wheldon, gibt sich ahnungslos. Denn er behauptet zwar der Besitzer des Hauses, jedoch nicht Bewohner zu sein.

programme.title: CSI: Den Tätern auf der Spur

programme.title: CSI: Den Tätern auf der Spur

programme.title: Asesinos a Sueldo
programme.desc: Traicionado por aquellos en quienes más confiaba, un sicario novato del gobierno descubre que es el objetivo del asesino más peligroso del mundo y comienza un juego despiadado de matar primero o ser asesinado.

programme.title: Go Astro Boy Go!
programme.desc: Es un misterio por qué una ancianita está rompiendo reflectores frente a un centro turístico costero recién construido. El equipo pronto descubre que ZARA está tratando de ayudar a las tortugas recién nacidas a llegar desde sus nidos hasta el mar. Pero la confusa contaminación lumínica no es la única amenaza que enfrentan, los depredadores acechan y un derrame de petróleo en el mar las espera. Es una batalla en tres frentes para salvar a las tortugas, pero los niños tienen tres cosas a su favor: superpoderes, gran inteligencia y redes de seda de araña sintética.

programme.title: El Lobo
programme.desc: Desde 1973 hasta 1975, Mikel Lejarza, un agente de la policía secreta española con el nombre en clave "El Lobo", logró infiltrarse en los más altos círculos del grupo militante vasco ETA. Las revelaciones de Lejarza fueron tan impactantes que personalmente logró desmantelar casi una cuarta parte de toda la organización. Hace unos años, el productor Melchor Miralles estableció contacto con El Lobo y lo convenció para que contara su historia.

programme.desc: El esposo de una mujer casada con una vida perfecta engaña a su hermana, con consecuencias extremas.

programme.title: La vida que te espera
programme.desc: Una pelea por el ternero de una vaca lechera premiada en Cantabria deja a un granjero muerto.

programme.title: Boogie: El Aceitoso
programme.desc: Boogie es un asesino a sueldo violento, despiadado y de sangre fría que sigue sus propias reglas. Las mujeres lo aman, los criminales le temen y su habilidad para matar le precede. Explotando con ironía, alcohol y balas ininterrumpidas, esta es una película animada en 3D asombrosa y llena de acción.

programme.title: Africa's Hunters of the Night
programme.desc: Por la noche, los cazadores de África salen de sus escondites. La película presenta las diferentes estrategias mortales que los leones, leopardos y hienas utilizan para cazar por la noche. Están equipados con "supersentidos" que les permiten encontrar a sus presas en completa oscuridad mientras ellos permanecen invisibles. Lentes extremadamente sensibles a la luz y cámaras térmicas revelan una lucha dramática a lo largo de la noche.

programme.title: USS Seaviper: Mision al Abismo
programme.desc: El submarino alemán U-234, del puerto de Kiel, comercia con los japoneses. El USS Seaviper debe localizar y detener este peligroso intercambio. El capitán del USS Seaviper debe desembarcar para realizar un reconocimiento en una isla cerca de Sumatra, pero el barco queda en manos de Mister Cutter, después de que el oficial ejecutivo resulta herido en batalla. Un conflicto entre Cutter y el jefe del barco pone al submarino en peligro. Seaviper está atrapado debajo de la superficie, con menos oxígeno, y un destructor japonés los caza desde arriba. Los daños sufridos por el barco también ponen en duda su supervivencia. Deben luchar contra el destructor japonés y llevar la información sobre el U-235 a Pearl Harbor.

programme.title: Boogie: El Aceitoso

Explotando con ironía, alcohol y balas ininterrumpidas, esta es una película animada en 3D asombrosa y llena de acción.

programme.title: Cerco de Terror 26/11 – La Serie
programme.desc: Lo que al principio parece violencia de pandillas se convierte en un ataque terrorista coordinado. Varios lugares de Mumbai — CST, Café Leopold, Hotel Taj, Oberoi y Chabad House — son atacados al mismo tiempo. Parvati aprovecha el caos para demostrar su valentía periodística.

programme.title: Lockhart: Liberando el Talisman
programme.desc: La vida normal de un hombre da un vuelco cuando hereda un antiguo artefacto de cristal y se convierte en "la clave" para liberar al mundo del dominio de la esclavitud energética y del Gobierno Mundial Único clandestino. Después de un intenso y peligroso trabajo de detective, Jon Lockhart descubre que la familia Lockhart ha estado ocultando el cristal, también conocido como "El Corazón", de los malvados Illuminati durante los últimos 1.000 años, desde la época de Robert the Bruce y las Cruzadas. El Corazón de Cristal contiene un código científico que puede generar suficiente energía limpia e ilimitada para alimentar al mundo entero. Ahora Jon debe encontrar una manera de proteger el secreto de su familia y el futuro suministro de energía manteniendo el Corazón de Cristal a salvo de la élite "Illuminati", que no se detendrá ante nada para encontrar el corazón y finalmente controlar el suministro de energía del mundo para siempre.

programme.title: Cassidy Roja
programme.desc: Una mujer regresa a su ciudad natal cuando su amante es asesinado por su desdeñoso ex prometido, en busca de una venganza sedienta de sangre. Dividida entre el amor, el odio, la lealtad y la venganza, su camino para buscar satisfacción se ensancha fuera de su control.

programme.title: Venganza al Trono
programme.desc: Una epopeya de espadas y brujería ambientada a finales del siglo XIII en Malta. Un grupo de guerreros maltrechos topa con un fuerte después de una sangrienta batalla. Los acontecimientos rápidamente se convierten en un torbellino de intriga, sexo y brutales enfrentamientos medievales.

В ”реалния” свят зоопазачът Франк поглъща противния вирус Тракс. Така попадаме в дълбините на грандиозната вътрешност на тялото - царството “Град на Франк”. Тук, от незачитащата нормите бяла кръвна клетка-ченге Осмозис Джоунс и неговия другар по неволя, хапчето против настинка Дрикс, зависи да попречат да се разпространи започнатата от Тракс епидемия на злото.
